title: It was great!
text: Two weeks ago, Su Hai wanted to play Mulan in a school play. It was her first school play. She wanted to try her best.
There were a lot of words in the play. She asked Su Yang to practise with her. There were also a lot of movements. She used her dancing skills to do them well.
